daily.today_energy: Your intuition is running hot today, Cancer. Trust those gut feelings—they're basically your superpower right now. Channel that inner knowing into whatever you're building, whether it's creative projects or deeper connections.
daily.love: Someone's noticing the quiet magic you've been radiating. If you're coupled up, it's a solid day for vulnerable conversations. Single? Stay open—genuine connections happen when you stop trying to script them.
daily.career: Your ideas have real weight today. Don't undersell your contributions or wait for permission to speak up. The energy supports you taking up space and owning what you've accomplished. Your effort matters.
daily.health: Your body's asking for grounding right now—touch grass, feel the sun, move slowly. Mental energy is high but your nervous system might need a breather. Gentle stretching or a walk hits different today.

weekly.overview: This week, your intuition is basically glowing. The cosmos is inviting you to trust those gut feelings that have been whispering to you. Lean into conversations that feel authentic, and don't be afraid to show up differently than before.
weekly.love: Connection energy is real right now. Whether you're partnered or solo, there's an invitation to be vulnerable in ways that feel safe. Someone might be trying to get closer—pay attention to the signs. Your heart knows what it needs.
weekly.career: Creative momentum is building, even if it doesn't look like traditional 'progress' yet. This is your week to explore ideas without judging them immediately. Share that project you've been sitting on. Someone's listening more than you think.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness this week. Movement that feels good (not punishing) is calling you. Notice what makes you feel grounded—whether that's time outside, rest, or something creative. Listen to those signals without overthinking.
